sections.content:
16,300 people

were counted on the census as "web design professionals" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Web design professionals design, develop and maintain websites and web and mobile applications to meet a client�s specified requirements.

How old are people who do this job?

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 30 to 34 years. Of the whole working population 12% were aged 30 to 34 years. For people working as "web design professionals", 20.2% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "web design professionals" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.footer: Source: Census 2021 from Office for National Statistics

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "web design professionals" included:

  • programmers and software development professionals
  • graphic and multimedia designers
  • IT quality and testing professionals

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "web design professionals" there were more men than women (64.1% compared with 35.9%).

This means "web design professionals" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "science, research, engineering and technology professionals".

Men made up 64.1% and women made up 35.9% of "web design professionals"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "web design professionals" included:

  • chartered architectural technologists, planning officers and consultants
  • IT quality and testing professionals
  • prison service officers (below principal officer)

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "web design professionals" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged under 30 years old, we see there is a higher proportion of women with this occupation than men.

The percentage of men and women who are "web design professionals" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "web design professionals", 9.9% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had more people aged between 30 and 49 years compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (80.6% compared with 19.4%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (68.7%) than self-employed (31.3%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was London. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Hackney, this is in the same region of London.
